title: LankaPay tells LankaSign registrants their personal details may have been exposed in a registration portal breach
date_note: Daily Mirror (23 November) reports LankaPay's notice to registrants but gives no date for the notice, the incident or its detection; the article's publication day is used.
geo_basis: Sri Lanka's national payment network operator; pinned at Colombo as the country, the article gives no location
summary: LankaPay told registrants of LankaSign, its digital signature service, that their personal details may have been exposed through its registration portal, according to a notice reported by the Daily Mirror. The notice says the incident is confined to that data collection portal and that no payment systems or digital signature platforms were affected. The Daily Mirror says the notice did not give how many registrants were affected or when it happened.
plain: Sri Lanka's payment network operator says personal details of people who signed up for its digital signature service may have been exposed through a sign-up website. It says payment systems were not affected.
exec: A national payment operator's registration portal for digital signatures may have exposed registrants' personal details; it says payment systems were unaffected.
action: No action needed; for awareness. LankaPay's notice directs registrants with concerns to its Data Protection Officer, as the Daily Mirror reports.

key_findings: Notice to LankaSign registrants signed by LankaPay Deputy CEO Dinuka Perera
Personal details of people who registered for LankaSign may have been exposed
LankaPay: incident confined to the data collection portal; no payment systems or digital signature platforms affected
Notice gave no count of affected registrants, no date of the incident or detection, and no account of how the portal was compromised
recommendations: Registrants with concerns are directed to LankaPay's Data Protection Officer

validation.note: One publisher (Daily Mirror) quoting LankaPay's notice to registrants; the notice itself was not found on lankapay.net (news listing read, latest item May 2026). The article body is presented under an 'AI summary' heading on the page.
